outcome.technical: RULE 1 (plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_floor_guard.py). A new test definition is a unit only where the base copy cannot have bound its name. Two readings of the base copy, asked lazily (only when a new definition would otherwise be a unit), by `_bound_by(key, name, readings)` from `_new_test_aside`: (i) `_string_words(base_text)` - every word (a run of letters, digits, underscores) of every str or bytes constant (bytes decoded utf-8/replace), f-string constant pieces, docstrings and reasons included; read from the base TEXT because `_parse_test` blanks a reason's text; `test_a` inside `test_alpha` is no match. (ii) `_computed_scopes(base_ast)` - {scope: (line, what)}, scope '' the module or the class key `_test_key` gives. Forms are rows of data, one predicate each: `_COMPUTED` = a subscript store into what globals()/locals()/vars() hands out; a write through it (update, setdefault, __setitem__); setattr; a store into a module's attribute through sys.modules; type(...) of three arguments; exec or eval; a star import. Each predicate returns where it binds: the scope whose own statement holds it (any block depth, not inside a nested function or class; head expressions of a def or class count for the enclosing scope; lambdas and comprehensions inside a statement count), the module from anywhere (globals() stores and writes, exec/eval handed globals(), setattr on sys.modules[...]), or a class by name from anywhere (setattr(TestA, ...)). `_CLASS_COMPUTED` = a class decorator that is not a skip or a mark (`_MARKING_DECORATORS`: unittest.skip/skipIf/skipUnless/expectedFailure, pytest.mark.*), a metaclass keyword, a base class of the same copy that runs code for each subclass (`_subclass_hooks`: defines __init_subclass__ or has a metaclass, transitively). Applied to every new definition that would otherwise be a unit, the rename branch included. A held definition stays in the rest, so its file is not compared, only added, with the same payload as a non-bare new test (notRead entry {path, move 'definition-changed', reason, kind 'could-hold-one'}; no key added or renamed); the reason gains one clause per held test: '`TestA.test_gen` is no new test, since the base copy holds its name inside a string and binds names by computation in the scope it lands in (a store into ..., at line 5 of the base copy)'. The clause avoids the words 'tree line N'/'base line N' that readers count. The SET_ASIDE row 2 reason now says the base copy cannot have bound the name - mentioned nowhere as an identifier or inside a string, in a scope binding nothing by computation; the table's shape and row names are unchanged. RULE 3 made true of the code: an answer with findings now carries `_units_text` in its basis too, so a check whose label gained a value is reported gone (part `gone`) and the new label is listed as new in the basis.
